style: Cinematic photorealistic film still, 16:9 widescreen, epic scale, one strong focal subject, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting with deep shadows and luminous highlights, rich teal-and-gold colour grade, atmospheric haze, 35mm anamorphic look.
negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no captions, no logos, no borders, no watermark.

art.gods-jubilee: Dawn in ancient Israel. On a rocky hilltop in the right third of the frame, a bearded man in a simple linen robe and head cloth lifts a long curved ram's horn to his lips, rim-lit against an enormous blazing golden sunrise. Below him a wide valley of terraced fields and a small walled village; tiny figures of men, women and children pour out of the gate and run toward the fields with their arms raised. On the rock in the foreground lie broken iron shackles and a snapped chain. Shafts of light break through towering clouds. The upper left of the frame is darker sky, left clear and uncluttered.
art.holy-spirit-dove: A white dove descending with wings fully spread, seen from slightly below, bursting out of a tear in dark storm clouds in a blazing shaft of golden-white light, rays fanning out around the bird, small sparks and embers of fire drifting in the light. Far below, small and dark, a crowd of silhouetted people lift their hands toward the light. The dove is in the right half of the frame; the left half is darker cloud, left clear and uncluttered.
art.noah-ark: The enormous wooden ark of Noah, almost finished, towering on timber scaffolding on a dry plain at dusk. In the foreground an old bearded man in a rough robe stands on a raised timber platform, one arm stretched back toward the ark, the other toward a vast crowd of people in ancient dress from many nations, some laughing at him, some uneasy and looking at the sky. Behind the ark a wall of black storm cloud rolls in with distant lightning, while the last sunlight strikes the hull gold. The upper left of the frame is dark cloud, left clear and uncluttered.
art.purpose-ambition: A lone man stands at a fork in a road at dawn, seen from behind, small against the landscape. The left road runs down toward a glittering modern city of glass towers under cold blue light. The right road is a narrow track climbing a hill toward a brilliant warm sunrise breaking through clouds, and he has turned to face it. The man is in the right half of the frame; the upper left is dark sky, left clear and uncluttered.
art.apostle-thomas: The year AD 52. On a palm-fringed beach of the Malabar coast of south India at golden dawn, a bearded Middle Eastern man of about fifty in a simple first-century robe and cloak, a wooden staff in his hand, wades ashore through the surf from a wooden Roman-era merchant sailing ship anchored behind him. On the sand, Indian fishermen and villagers in first-century south Indian dress stand beside dugout boats and watch him come. Coconut palms, warm sea mist, shafts of sunrise light. The man is in the right half of the frame; the upper left is darker palms and sky, left clear and uncluttered.
